
```jsx
import { CxCarouselItem } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxCarouselItem from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/carousel/CxCarouselItem'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **interval** | The amount of time to delay between automatically cycling an item. | `number` \| `boolean` \| `undefined` | false |
